verdict.rationale: AutoGen's AssistantAgent/tool-use and AutoGen Studio provide a way to build agents that can analyze data and produce results (e.g., 'Find information on AutoGen' task, group research examples), but this requires custom agent/tool setup rather than an out-of-box 'insights from my data' feature baked into a product surface. Missing for 10: first-party data-connector or dashboard-style insights feature, evidence of automatic proactive suggestions surfaced in a UI, and independent corroboration of insight quality (community feedback even notes weaker output vs direct model use in autogen-comm-5).
